subject: Meridian POC — acceptance criteria, operational runbook & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@meridian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian POC — acceptance criteria, operational runbook & next steps

Hi Lina / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the Meridian product and ML teams. As promised, I'm summarizing the proposed POC structure and the measurable success criteria so we can lock scope and owners. I've attached a one-page POC charter (meridian-poc-charter.xlsx) and a sample load profile.

High-level objective:
- Validate integration of Redwood Inference with Meridian's document ingestion pipeline and meet production-like latency/cost/quality targets for the primary summarization endpoint.

Proposed success metrics (concrete, testable):
- Latency (p95): <= 350 ms for 512-token requests under steady-state load (see load profile).
- Throughput: sustain 1k RPS/min burst capacity with autoscale across 4 workers (target average 600 req/min).
- Cost per 1k tokens: target < $0.60 (equivalent to $0.0006/token) based on quantized model variant; we'll report token-level breakdowns.
- Quality: automated fidelity checks (ROUGE-L/ROUGE-1 baseline) + human acceptance. Target: >= 88% automated pass rate on curated test prompts, and >= 90% acceptance in a 30-sample human review.

Timeline (proposed):
1) Week 0 (kickoff + infra prep): 2 business days — access, security checklist, SRE contacts.
2) Week 1 (sandbox): bring up private sandbox, ingest 10k documents, smoke tests.
3) Week 2-3 (evaluation): run evaluation harness, track KPIs, collect human review.
4) Week 4 (readout + decision): deliver readout and recommendation.

Owners / contacts:
- Meridian: Lina Park (PM), Tom Kim (ML lead)
- Redwood: Dylan Brooks (AE, overall owner), Ben Carter (Solutions Eng, test harness & perf), Grace O'Connor (Customer Success)

Immediate asks from Redwood:
- Share a small anonymized sample dataset (500 docs) by EOD Friday so Ben can validate tokenization and initial QA metrics.
- Confirm whether Meridian needs VPC/private deployment for the sandbox or if hosted sandbox is acceptable.

If that looks right, I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next Wednesday and loop in Security for the SOC2 questionnaire.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0123 | dylan@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Dylan,

Appreciate the clear recap — this matches our internal discussion. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Timeline: week-by-week plan looks good. One tweak: can we compress the sandbox to 3 business days and extend evaluation to three weeks (to allow for broader sampling across modalities)? Our ML team has capacity to prioritize.
- Cost target: $0.0006/token is reasonable as a goal; we'd like visibility into how quantization choices affect quality.
- Security: we require a SOC2 questionnaire and an IP/data-processing addendum before ingesting production data. Our legal will send a standard DPA template; can your legal contact confirm lead?

We can provide a 500-doc anonymized sample by Friday EOD — I'll upload to the Drive link you provided. For the sandbox, hosted is fine to start; if performance looks good we'll opt for a VPC staging cluster in Week 2.

Next steps: please get Ben to send the sample harness and any credential instructions. Let's tentatively hold kickoff for Wed 27 May 10:00 PT — I'll confirm.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Senior Product Manager, Meridian Labs
